extracted.name: Bacon Pea Salad
extracted.description: Fresh peas, bacon, celery, onion, and cheese are tossed in a creamy dressing creating a lovely summer salad to bring to picnics.
ingredient_lines: salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Place bacon in a large skillet and cook over medium-high heat, turning occasionally, until evenly browned, about 10 minutes. Drain bacon slices on paper towels and crumble. Reserve 1 tablespoon bacon grease.
Whisk mayonnaise, reserved bacon grease, honey, sugar, salt, and black pepper together in a bowl until dressing is smooth.
Mix bacon, peas, celery, Cheddar cheese, and onion together in a bowl. Drizzle dressing over salad and toss to coat.
